title: Cherry Cobblemon Modpack
body:
Offical modpack for the Cherry Cobblemon server.
IP: 74.112.77.164:9060

This modpack is for features such as mega evolution, trainer battles, and TMs.

This is a very new simple server that is mostly vanilla with a few settings changed.

The server features custom mods, raids, npc trainers, a basic ruleset, survival experience, admins that do not cheat, trivia, a GTS, monthly mystery gifts/kits, boosted shiny rate, boosted spawn rate, player and server shops with different currencies, and no pay to win or donations of any kind.

The intent is for the server to have a survival experience without people getting quickly overpowered but still having not have a ridiculous grind.

We have a discord server that can join with this link: [https://discord.gg/95mxCabJWf](https://discord.gg/95mxCabJWf). An official website and dedicated IP might be implemented in the future.
